campaign.body:

Limited period offer — order now!

scheme.title: 💰 Monsoon Protection Scheme
scheme.body:
Buy 100 bags JK Super OPC 53 Grade → Get 5 bags FREE + ₹2,000 ZoPs credited to your account.

Valid till 31 Aug 2026.

Tap below to place your order with scheme pricing applied automatically.

aiTyping.body: Scheme query detected, ZoAi is composing a response...

aiResponse.title: ZoAi Scheme Explanation
aiResponse.body: Bhai, is scheme mein aapko har 100 bags OPC 53 par 5 bags FREE mil rahe hain. Matlab aap 100 bags ka pay karenge aur 105 bags ka maal milega. Plus ₹2,000 ZoPoints jo next order mein discount ki tarah use kar sakte hain. Scheme 31 Aug 2026 tak valid hai. Kya aap order dena chahenge? 😊

loyaltyQuery.title: 🏆 ZoAi — Points & Loyalty
loyaltyQuery.body: Ramesh bhai, aapke current loyalty points 12,500 hain. Aap inhe next order mein ₹12,500 ke discount mein badal sakte hain. Aapka loyalty tier 'Gold' hai — 5% extra discount on all orders. Kya aap points redeem karna chahenge? 😊
